name: nodejs-movy-data
description: Database-agnostic migration tool. Migrates schema and data between PostgreSQL, MySQL and MSSQL.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @movy/core && npm run build -w @movy/cli && npm run build -w @movy/runner
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @movy/core && npm run typecheck -w @movy/cli
